blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian on Thursday said the 13-1 vote to overturn the 16-vote conviction threshold does not indicate how senator-judges will vote on whether to convict or acquit Vice President Sara Duterte in her impeachment trial. “No, that’s far off. Because when it comes to the verdict, it’s about the evidence, it’s about the testimonies, it’s about how the prosecution and defense will present their cases,” Gatchalian said in an ambush interview. “That’s not the vote to convict. That’s also not the vote to acquit,” he added. His statement came as reporters asked whether the 13 senators […]...
